title: Understand the changes in your coffee leaves.
introduction: A photo, a few answers, and a useful record for a local agricultural officer. Crop Health Assistant provides initial screening, not a confirmed diagnosis.
availabilityTitle: Photo screening is not available yet
availabilityText: We are building the screening journey. Photos, AI results and report downloads will be added next.

journey.title: Add leaf photos
journey.description: Take a clear photo of one affected coffee leaf in natural light.

journey.title: Share what you noticed
journey.description: Answer a few short questions. You can choose Not sure.

journey.title: Read the observations
journey.description: See visible symptoms, uncertainty and guidance suitable for your region, when available.

journey.title: Prepare a report
journey.description: Download a record to share with a local agricultural officer yourself.

uncertaintyText: A photo cannot confirm a disease or show that a plant is healthy.
regionalText: Guidance reviewed for PNG will not be assumed suitable everywhere. When local guidance is missing, we will explain that and suggest a local agricultural officer.
sessionTitle: One check in the open tab
sessionText: The planned screening needs an internet connection. Refreshing or closing the tab will clear your assessment. Only language preference is remembered on your device.
translationNotice: Tok Pisin text is a draft and has not been reviewed by a fluent speaker.
footer: Coffee is the only planned MVP crop. PNG users are the first validation group; validation is still pending.
screeningStatement: Initial screening, not a confirmed diagnosis.

assessment.intro: Coffee farmers everywhere are welcome. We are starting validation with PNG users. Agricultural and language review are still pending.
assessment.photoTitle: Start with a clear coffee leaf photo.
assessment.photoHelp: Use natural light and include the whole affected leaf. Add an underside photo when useful. Avoid faces, documents and identifying details.
assessment.limits: One or two JPEG, PNG or WebP photos. Maximum 10 MiB and 40 megapixels per original. Resized copies are sent, at most 1600 pixels on the long edge and 2 MiB each. Convert HEIC to JPEG first.
assessment.privacy: Photos and answers are sent to this app server and Google when you select Check photos or Get screening result. The app does not intentionally save case data. Google processing and retention terms still apply. Only language preference is remembered on this device.
assessment.temporary: Refreshing or closing this tab clears your photos, answers and results. Downloads remain on your device until you delete them. Screening requires internet.
assessment.demoPrivacy: This internal demonstration may use the free Gemini service. Only submit permitted sample data, with permission for this use under Google service terms. Do not submit private farmer data.
assessment.paidPrivacy: The configured paid Gemini service processes submissions. This prototype is still awaiting agricultural and language review.
assessment.permission: I have permission to use these photos and answers for this demonstration.
assessment.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Your inputs remain in this tab.
assessment.questionHelp: Choose an answer for each of the four questions. Not sure is a valid answer. No reviewed follow up questions are available yet.
assessment.confirmClear: Clear this assessment? Photos, answers and results will be removed from this tab.
assessment.countryTitle: Which country or region is your coffee grown in?
assessment.countryHelp: Advice can differ by location. This is optional guidance context, not an access restriction. No precise location is needed.
assessment.countryEnglish: Country names are shown in English.
assessment.regionStale: Regional guidance is not current. Update it before exporting.
assessment.coverage: No conditions have completed review and evaluation. This demonstration provides visible observations only. It cannot identify a supported disease or confirm plant health.
assessment.unsupported: The photos may be outside the coffee leaf scope. Please ask a local agricultural officer to review them.
assessment.initial: This is automated initial screening. It does not confirm a disease or show that the plant is healthy.
assessment.noRegional: We do not have approved guidance for your country or region. Please ask a local agricultural officer to review these observations.
assessment.unknownRegional: Your country or region is not known, so guidance applicability cannot be checked. Please ask a local agricultural officer to review these observations.
assessment.pngPending: PNG specific review is pending. No agricultural validation has been completed for worldwide use.
assessment.noMissing: No additional evidence gaps were listed. The screening limits still apply.
assessment.no_clear_supported_signs: No clear signs of a supported condition
assessment.reportHelp: The report uses the current photos, answers, region and checked observations. You choose who to share it with. Nothing is sent automatically to an officer.
assessment.downloaded: The PDF was created and a download was requested. Check your browser downloads.
assessment.exportError: The PDF could not be created. Your assessment is retained. Try again or use Print report.
assessment.processed: Photos are resized copies. Original photos remain on your device.
assessment.noResult: No screening result was produced. This report records an incomplete attempt.
assessment.share: The farmer shares this report manually. No officer review or delivery is implied.
assessment.automatic: Observations automatically translated into Tok Pisin. Meaning has not been reviewed for this case.
assessment.translationUnavailable: Tok Pisin observations are unavailable. You can choose to view these sections in English. Screening will not run again.
assessment.englishFallback: English observation and evidence limitation sections, accepted fallback
assessment.fixedDraft: Tok Pisin interface and report text is a draft awaiting fluent review.
assessment.noTranslationExport: Choose the English observation fallback before exporting this report.
assessment.needPhoto: Add at least one valid photo.
assessment.needPermission: Please confirm permission before sending sample data.
assessment.needAnswers: Choose an answer for all four questions. You can select Not sure.
assessment.needCountry: Choose a country, Not sure or Not provided.
assessment.processing: Preparing the photo on this device
assessment.remaining: Screening attempts remaining in this session
assessment.enableNote: Screening is paused until Gemini access and server configuration are ready. You can still prepare photos locally.

errors.disabled: Screening is currently disabled. No screening result was produced. Your photos remain in this tab.
errors.unavailable: The screening service is unavailable. Your inputs are retained. Try again later.
errors.timeout: The request timed out. Your inputs are retained.
errors.invalid_input: The submitted fields could not be accepted. Check your inputs.
errors.invalid_image: The photo could not be decoded safely. Replace it with a clear JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.format: This file format is not supported. Convert HEIC to JPEG. Animated photos, SVG and documents are not accepted.
errors.too_large: The photo or submission exceeds the size limits. Choose a smaller photo.
errors.invalid_output: The response could not be checked. No screening result was produced.
errors.expired: The temporary session or result expired. Check photos again to continue. Your inputs are retained.
errors.busy: A request is already running or the service is busy. Wait, then try again.
errors.quota: The request allowance is exhausted. Wait before retrying. Your inputs are retained.
errors.origin: This request must come from this app. Reload the app before retrying.
errors.demo_only: Only permitted demonstration data can be submitted in this service mode.
errors.translation_unavailable: Tok Pisin translation is unavailable. You can choose English observations.
errors.network: The request could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.photo_failed: This photo could not be prepared. Check the format, size and dimensions, then choose another photo.

onset.label: When did you first notice the symptoms?

spread.label: Is this affecting one plant or several plants?

care_change.label: Have watering, shade or plant care practices changed?
